original_target.title: Uniqueness of the critical catenoid
original_target.outcome: Claim: affirmative uniqueness of the critical catenoid

scope_comparison: The announced Corollary1.2 gives uniqueness up to rotation of every properly embedded free-boundary minimal annulus in the unit3-ball. Local hypotheses impose exactly smoothness, proper embedding, annular topology and orthogonal boundary meeting; no extra reflection symmetry is required. The standard critical-catenoid parametrization is the same object.
